definition: בַּ֫עַל חֶרְמוֺן proper name, of a location Judg 3:3 ; 1Chr 5:23 , a city so named as seat of the worship of Baal. 'The crest of Hermon is strewn with ruins and the foundations of a circular temple of large hewn stones,' Tristr Tpg , compare on sacredness, Euseb. Lag Onom 217: possibly = בעל גד q. v.
